title: Ten years
description: OpenAI reflects on ten years of progress, from early research breakthroughs to widely used AI systems that reshaped what’s possible. We share lessons from the past decade and why we remain optimistic about building AGI that benefits all of humanity.
author: Desconocido

title: Update to GPT-5 System Card: GPT-5.2
description: GPT-5.2 is the latest model family in the GPT-5 series. The comprehensive safety mitigation approach for these models is largely the same as that described in the GPT-5 System Card and GPT-5.1 System Card. Like OpenAI’s other models, the GPT-5.2 models were trained on diverse datasets, including information that is publicly available on the internet, information that we partner with third parties to access, and information that our users or human trainers and researchers provide or generate.
author: Desconocido

title: Introducing GPT-5.2
description: GPT-5.2 is our most advanced frontier model for everyday professional work, with state-of-the-art reasoning, long-context understanding, coding, and vision. Use it in ChatGPT and the OpenAI API to power faster, more reliable agentic workflows.
author: Desconocido

title: The Walt Disney Company and OpenAI reach landmark agreement to bring beloved characters to Sora
description: Disney and OpenAI have reached an agreement to bring more than 200 Disney, Marvel, Pixar and Star Wars characters to Sora for fan-inspired short videos. The agreement emphasizes responsible AI in entertainment and includes Disney’s company-wide use of ChatGPT Enterprise and the OpenAI API.
author: Desconocido

title: Increasing revenue 300% by bringing AI to SMBs
description: Discover how Podium used OpenAI’s GPT-5 to build “Jerry,” an AI teammate driving 300% growth and transforming how Main Street businesses serve customers.
author: Desconocido

title: Strengthening cyber resilience as AI capabilities advance
description: OpenAI is investing in stronger safeguards and defensive capabilities as AI models become more powerful in cybersecurity. We explain how we assess risk, limit misuse, and work with the security community to strengthen cyber resilience.
author: Desconocido

title: How Scout24 is building the next generation of real-estate search with AI
description: Scout24 has created a GPT-5 powered conversational assistant that reimagines real-estate search, guiding users with clarifying questions, summaries, and tailored listing recommendations.
author: Desconocido

title: OpenAI co-founds Agentic AI Foundation, donates AGENTS.md
description: OpenAI co-founds the Agentic AI Foundation under the Linux Foundation and donates AGENTS.md to support open, interoperable standards for safe agentic AI.
author: Desconocido

title: Launching our first OpenAI Certifications courses
description: Learn how OpenAI’s new certifications and AI Foundations courses help people build real-world AI skills, boost career opportunities, and prepare for the future of work.
author: Desconocido

title: OpenAI appoints Denise Dresser as Chief Revenue Officer
description: Denise Dresser is joining as Chief Revenue Officer, overseeing OpenAI’s global revenue strategy across enterprise and customer success. She will help more businesses put AI to work in their day-to-day operations as OpenAI continues to scale.
author: Desconocido

title: Bringing powerful AI to millions across Europe with Deutsche Telekom
description: OpenAI is collaborating with Deutsche Telekom to bring advanced, multilingual AI experiences to millions of people across Europe. ChatGPT Enterprise will also be deployed to help employees at Deutsche Telekom improve workflows and accelerate innovation.
author: Desconocido

title: Building AI fluency at scale with ChatGPT Enterprise
description: Commonwealth Bank of Australia partners with OpenAI to roll out ChatGPT Enterprise to 50,000 employees, building AI fluency at scale to improve customer service and fraud response.
author: Desconocido

title: Instacart and OpenAI partner on AI shopping experiences
description: OpenAI and Instacart are deepening their longstanding partnership by bringing the first fully integrated grocery shopping and Instant Checkout payment app to ChatGPT.
author: Desconocido

title: The state of enterprise AI
description: Key findings from OpenAI’s enterprise data show accelerating AI adoption, deeper integration, and measurable productivity gains across industries in 2025.
author: Desconocido

title: How Virgin Atlantic uses AI to enhance every step of travel
description: Virgin Atlantic CFO Oliver Byers shares how the airline is using AI to speed up development, improve decision-making, and elevate customer experience.
author: Desconocido

title: Introducing OpenAI for Australia
description: OpenAI is launching OpenAI for Australia to build sovereign AI infrastructure, upskill more than 1.5 million workers, and accelerate innovation across the country’s growing AI ecosystem.
author: Desconocido

title: OpenAI to acquire Neptune
description: OpenAI is acquiring Neptune to deepen visibility into model behavior and strengthen the tools researchers use to track experiments and monitor training.
author: Desconocido

title: How confessions can keep language models honest
description: OpenAI researchers are testing “confessions,” a method that trains models to admit when they make mistakes or act undesirably, helping improve AI honesty, transparency, and trust in model outputs.
author: Desconocido

title: Announcing the initial People-First AI Fund grantees
description: The OpenAI Foundation announces the initial recipients of the People-First AI Fund, awarding $40.5M in unrestricted grants to 208 nonprofits supporting community innovation and opportunity.
author: Desconocido

title: Inside Mirakl’s Agent Commerce Vision
description: Mirakl is redefining commerce through AI agents and ChatGPT Enterprise—achieving faster documentation, smarter customer support, and building toward agent-native commerce with Mirakl Nexus.
author: Desconocido

title: Funding grants for new research into AI and mental health
description: OpenAI is awarding up to $2 million in grants for research at the intersection of AI and mental health. The program supports projects that study real-world risks, benefits, and applications to improve safety and well-being.
author: Desconocido

title: OpenAI and NORAD team up to bring new magic to “NORAD Tracks Santa”
description: OpenAI and NORAD are bringing new magic to “NORAD Tracks Santa” with three ChatGPT holiday tools that let families create festive elves, toy coloring pages, and custom Christmas stories.
author: Desconocido

title: OpenAI takes an ownership stake in Thrive Holdings to accelerate enterprise AI adoption
description: OpenAI takes an ownership stake in Thrive Holdings to accelerate enterprise AI adoption, embedding frontier research and engineering directly into accounting and IT services to boost speed, accuracy, and efficiency while creating a scalable model for industry-wide transformation.
author: Desconocido

title: Accenture and OpenAI accelerate enterprise AI success
description: Accenture is rolling out 40,000 ChatGPT Enterprise licenses and naming OpenAI its primary intelligence partner to power enterprise AI success, upskill teams, and deliver AI-driven client outcomes.
author: Desconocido

title: Mixpanel security incident: what OpenAI users need to know
description: OpenAI shares details about a Mixpanel security incident involving limited API analytics data. No API content, credentials, or payment details were exposed. Learn what happened and how we’re protecting users.
author: Desconocido

title: Expanding data residency access to business customers worldwide
description: OpenAI expands data residency for ChatGPT Enterprise, ChatGPT Edu, and the API Platform, enabling eligible customers to store data at rest in-region.
author: Desconocido

title: Our approach to mental health-related litigation
description: We’re sharing our approach to mental health-related litigation. O handle sensitive cases with care, transparency, and respect while continuing to strengthen safety and support in ChatGPT.
author: Desconocido

title: Inside JetBrains—the company reshaping how the world writes code
description: JetBrains is integrating GPT-5 across its coding tools, helping millions of developers design, reason, and build software faster.
author: Desconocido

title: GPT-5 and the future of mathematical discovery
description: UCLA Professor Ernest Ryu and GPT-5 solved a key question in optimization theory, showcasing AI’s role in accelerating mathematical discovery.
author: Desconocido

title: Introducing shopping research in ChatGPT
description: Shopping research in ChatGPT helps you explore, compare, and discover products with personalized buyer’s guides that simplify decision-making
author: Desconocido
